transcript: Never move into a house rented or bought without doing this first. Save this video. This is done only once and it changes everything. Every house holds memories, even if you have no idea who lived there that space carries stories, emotions, arguments, fears, joys. And when you enter without preparing the environment, you begin to feel things that are not yours. Before bringing in your furniture, bring your intention. First open all the windows. Let the air move. Let the light come in. What is old needs to leave before what is new can settle. Second walk through each room in silence. No phone, no rush. Touch the walls. Touch the doors and say softly, from today this space is a place of peace, words, direct energy. Where your words go, your environment follows. Third throw a handful of salt into the toilet and flush. Salt has been used as a symbol of purification for centuries. As it goes down the drain, it represents everything that needs to leave. While you do this, say out loud, may all negative energy dissolve and be carried away. This is not superstition. This is about closing the cycle of what does not belong to you. Fourth light a white candle in the center of the house. Not as an empty ritual, but as a symbol of presence. The flame represents awareness. It represents a new beginning and while the candle burns declare what you want to live in that space, harmony, prosperity, respect, tranquility. It is not the ritual that transforms the house. It is the intention that transforms the space. When you arrive with consciousness, the space responds differently. Write in the comments, I bless my home if this made sense to you. And tell me if you have ever walked into a place and felt something strange in the air. That feeling you cannot explain, but you can sense. And if you feel that it is not just your home that needs cleansing, but everything you carry inside, the stress, the fears, the emotions that have been building up for years without anyone teaching you how to release them. I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that. And everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
